name: reward-bench-2
description: A dataset intended to evaluate reward/pairwise-preference models by providing human preference labels or reward scores for model-generated outputs. It measures how well a reward model or ranking method aligns with human judgments across provided comparison pairs or tasks.
evaluation_method: pairwise agreement accuracy and rank correlation (e.g., Spearman/Pearson) between model scores and human preferences
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face dataset with modest usage among researchers working on reward modeling and RLHF evaluation.
